predictions.articleTitle: Celta Vigo vs Bournemouth Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: High-Press xG vs Depleted Spine
predictions.coreRecommendation: Bournemouth project to claim an away victory at Balaidos behind a 47.8% blended model edge and a 2.23 to 1.19 xG per game attacking advantage.

Over 2.5 Goals backed by a 2.76 lambda total, 52.1% model probability, and 7 of 8 combined Europa League fixtures clearing 2.5 goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Bournemouth's high press targets Celta's Starfelt- and Roman-less spine.

spf.comment: Bournemouth's 2.23 xG per game, 4-0-0 Europa League record, and Celta's three confirmed spine absences center the projection on a 1:2 away victory.

over_under.comment: A 2.76 lambda total, 52.1% model Over 2.5 probability, and 7 of 8 combined European games going over support a 3-goal expectation.

btts.comment: Bournemouth hold an 80.6% scoring projection against zero Celta clean sheets, while Celta scored in both home UEL ties and Bournemouth conceded in both away UEL ties.

score.comment: 1:2 mirrors Celta's twin home UEL defeats and Bournemouth's road win at Real Sociedad, while 0:2 covers the branch where Celta's depleted attack is shut out.

goals.comment: Three total goals align with the primary 1:2 Over 2.5 script, while two goals represent the 24.7% Poisson mode tied to a 0:2 clean-sheet scenario.

bqc.comment: Bournemouth led at half-time in 3 of 4 UEL matches (Loss-Loss from home view), while Draw-Loss covers Celta holding level early before fading late.
